questions.question: In Inception, what object does Cobb use as a totem to tell dream from reality?
questions.note: Arthur’s totem is the die; Ariadne’s is the bishop. The top originally belonged to Mal.

questions.question: Who composed the scores for Inception, Interstellar, and Dunkirk?
questions.note: Williams is Star Wars and Harry Potter; Shore is The Lord of the Rings.

questions.question: Who directed the 2006 Spanish-language fantasy Pan’s Labyrinth?
questions.note: Cuarón made Y Tu Mamá También and Gravity; Iñárritu made The Revenant.

questions.question: Who played Imperator Furiosa in Mad Max: Fury Road?
questions.note: Hardy is Max. Kravitz is Toast the Knowing. George Miller directed the 2015 film.

questions.question: Who played the jazz conductor Terence Fletcher in Whiplash?
questions.note: He won Best Supporting Actor. Teller is the drummer, Andrew.

questions.question: Who was the first woman to win the Oscar for Best Director, for The Hurt Locker?
questions.note: The 2010 ceremony, beating her ex-husband James Cameron’s Avatar. Campion and Zhao won later.

questions.question: In Life of Pi, what is the name of the Bengal tiger sharing the lifeboat?
questions.note: 2012, directed by Ang Lee. The name also belongs to a shipwrecked tiger in a 19th-century case.

questions.question: In The Martian, what crop does Matt Damon’s character grow on Mars?
questions.note: 2015, directed by Ridley Scott. “I’m going to have to science the shit out of this.”

questions.question: What is the name of Daniel Craig’s detective in Knives Out?
questions.note: 2019, written and directed by Rian Johnson. The sequel is Glass Onion.

questions.question: In Her (2013), who voiced the operating system Samantha?
questions.note: Spike Jonze wrote and directed. Morton originally recorded the role and was recast. Mara plays the ex.
